query: What market-expansion focus should analysts study?

per_column.name: Industry Sector
per_column.rationale: A strong grouping axis for market-expansion analysis, letting analysts compare sectors. Most classifications are well grounded (23andMe->Healthcare, 5AM Ventures->VC, Addepar->Cloud/Enterprise Software is defensible). However '280 Group', a product management training/consulting firm, is labeled 'AI & Machine Learning' with no textual support, an invented specific. The catch-all 'Other Technology' (Accel, a VC, placed there rather than Venture Capital) also weakens grounding.

per_column.name: Geographic Cluster
per_column.rationale: Geographic clustering is directly relevant to market-expansion focus and provides a genuine grouping axis. But the produced values contradict the source addresses: 23andMe at 899 W Evelyn Ave (Mountain View area) is plausibly Core, yet 280 Group at 'S Santa Cruz Ave' (Los Gatos) labeled 'South Bay (San Jose)' is a stretch, and both Sand Hill Road entries (Menlo Park) are labeled 'Redwood City / San Mateo' rather than the Menlo Park corridor, contradicting the actual location. This misassignment lowers groundedness.

per_column.name: Market Expansion Potential
per_column.rationale: Directly targets the query and offers a rankable High/Medium/Low axis, so it is analytically useful. However the values are largely unsupported by the source text: nothing in the brief company descriptions or addresses warrants a confident High/Medium/Low expansion judgment (e.g., 23andMe->Low, Addepar->High, 280 Group->Medium appear asserted rather than derived). These look like invented confident specifics on silent inputs.

judge.rationale: All three columns give genuine, non-redundant axes (sector, geography, expansion score) that directly serve the market-expansion query, so analytical usefulness is high. Groundedness is the weak point: Industry Sector is mostly sound but has clear fabrications (280 Group as AI/ML), Geographic Cluster contradicts the actual addresses in several samples (Sand Hill Road/Menlo Park mislabeled), and Market Expansion Potential is an unsupported inferred rating with little textual basis. Notable hallucination risk across the added columns.
